faqs.a:
Any project or any interest therein not involving construction work appertaining to
               a capital improvement may be acquired or improved pursuant to any appropriate contract,
               or otherwise, including, without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the condemnation
               or other acquisition of real property. In such case nothing herein in the preceding
               section nor in
sections 78-50
—
78-64
, inclusive, shall be applicable.
(Code 1981, § 27-48; Ord. No. 551, § 18(B), 5-14-1964)
